description: "History of the United Netherlands from the Death of William the Silent to the Twelve Year's Truce--1609" by John Lothrop Motley is a historical account written in the mid-19th century. The book focuses on the political and military events surrounding the struggle of the Netherlands against Spanish rule following the death of the influential leader William the Silent.
